messages.en:
{07 07 00}I'm feeling a little woozy,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. I think I'd
better lie down.
messages.et:
{07 07 00}Mul on pisut uimane tunne,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}. Ma vist pean
pikali heitma.

messages.en:
{07 07 00}Ugh. I just can't wake up
today, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
And I ache all over. Bleh.
messages.et:
{07 07 00}Uhh. Ma lihtsalt ei suuda
täna ärgata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Ja mul valutab kõik. Pläh.

messages.en:
{07 07 00}I don't feel so hot today.
I hope I'm not coming down
with something.
messages.et:
{07 07 00}Ma ei tunne end hästi.
Loodan, et ma ei jää
millegagi haigeks.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I feel better. {01 00 00 0a 00}I guess the
{ff 00 00 07}medicine{ff 00 00 00} is starting to
work.
{07 14 00}I hereby proclaim
{ff 00 00 05}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} to be my hero!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tunnen end paremini. {01 00 00 0a 00}Vist
hakkab {ff 00 00 07}rohi{ff 00 00 00} mõjuma.

{07 14 00}Ma kuulutan käesolevaga
{ff 00 00 05}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} oma kangelaseks!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm gonna read to you from
my diary now, so listen
up.
"Dear Diary, {01 00 00 0a 00}I'm so glad
{ff 00 00 05}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}came along. {01 00 00 0a 00}The
{ff 00 00 07}medicine {ff 00 00 00}really helped."
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma loen sulle nüüd oma
päevikust ette, nii et
kuula.
„Kallis päevik, {01 00 00 0a 00}nii hea
meel, et {ff 00 00 05}{04 0f 00} {ff 00 00 00}tuli. {01 00 00 0a 00}See
{ff 00 00 07}rohi {ff 00 00 00}aitas tõesti.”
